Thanks Naomi. Jordan — I pulled the invite metadata from our side and the meeting was created under Naomi's account and the meeting URL is correct on the Redwood side (https://meet.redwood.com/g/abcd1234). Two hypotheses:

1) The forwarded ICS file that arrived at Novidemo has a truncated DESCRIPTION field and the transport replaced the long meeting URL with a shortlink that now resolves incorrectly. Some Exchange servers perform link-post-processing.
2) A calendar proxy (employee forwarding from mobile) caused the organizer token to be rewritten to a third-party shortlink.

Short term: Marissa, can you generate a plain-text ICS from Naomi's organizer account and resend? Jordan, if your IT can whitelist meet.redwood.com and shortlink.redwood.com for calendar rendering that will also help.

Jordan: attaching a copy of the invite we have (stubbed). If you can forward the raw .eml that will help.
